Chapter 1158: Chapter 21 My Name is ’Galaxy’ (Requesting Monthly Votes at the Beginning of the Month)_2

The Invincible Great Saints are extremely rare, and those peerless Great Saints who are close to becoming Invincible Great Saints are likewise not many, at least their strength needs to surpass others of the same level.

Originally, Tian Lu Great Saint and other Chaos Great Saints thought that the pioneer of this Postnatal Universe was just a normal peerless Great Saint, but a peerless Great Saint close to becoming an Invincible Great Saint?

Nine Phoenix Great Saint, Shadow Demon Great Saint, and several other Chaos Great Saints had similar changes in their thoughts.

A Postnatal Universe left by a peerless Great Saint close to an Invincible Great Saint might only appear once in countless Cosmic Eras.

For these newly advanced Great Saints, encountering such a level of Postnatal Universe is an unparalleled opportunity that cannot be sought. If they give up this time, they may never have such a chance again.

Thinking of this, Tian Lu Great Saint and other Chaos Great Saints made up their minds.

First, the value of this universe is even beyond their expectations.

Second, since Dual Origin Great Saint dares to involve them to resist Lin Yuan, there must be some confidence.

If there was nothing to rely on? Dual Origin Great Saint wouldn’t do this.

In just a moment, the eyes of the six Chaos Great Saints became firm.

They also do not believe that with the combined strength of nine Chaos Great Saints, they couldn’t contend with Lin Yuan?

...

"What happened?"

Each of the Chaos Venerables attracted by spacetime fluctuations, before they could even approach, saw that the distant spacetime seemed to be cut apart, with Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and other Chaos Great Saints all trapped inside.

"Is it that the nine Great Saints have begun to slaughter each other?"

"Tsk tsk, such spacetime confinement techniques have never been displayed outside before."

"Indeed, such a spacetime fluctuation must mean a great treasure has emerged, and these Great Saints are certainly going to battle for it."

...

Many Chaos Venerables watched from afar. With nine Great Saints present, they had no thoughts of obtaining the treasure but were curious which Great Saint would ultimately claim it.

...

"It seems that none of you wish to retreat."

Lin Yuan looked at the nine Chaos Great Saints with a slight smile and said, "In that case, all of you may stay."

Wow!

The spacetime from all directions began to contract rapidly, the external universe formed by the Divine Ability ’World’ could theoretically expand to trillions of light-years.

But that is the limit of the external universe, the smaller it gets, the more concentrated its power, and the greater the pressure it puts on the enemy.

"With such strength, what is your name?" Dual Origin Great Saint transformed back into cyan-gray light, while the surrounding spacetime continued to shatter and reorganize.

Immediately, the other eight Great Saints all looked at Lin Yuan.

Although Lin Yuan was extremely domineering, they had to admit that his strength was indeed very strong. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have compelled Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and others to join forces against him.

"Name?" Lin Yuan smiled gently, "I am ’Galaxy’."

Boom!

The vast spacetime surged like a tide, and the nine Chaos Great Saints seemed like lonely boats on an ocean, at risk of capsizing under the continual battering waves.

Initially, upon leaving the universe, Lin Yuan needed to be low-key to cultivate steadily, otherwise even the Ancient Ming Venerable was enough to threaten him and the human civilization group at that time.

But now?

Lin Yuan’s combat power had nearly reached the invincibility of a Chaos Great Saint, enough to traverse the Chaos Void. At this time, there was naturally no need to be low-key, nor was it necessary to be low-key.

"Galaxy?"

"Galaxy Great Saint?"

Dual Origin Great Saint frowned in thought. He had not heard of this name before.

This implied two possibilities.

One was that Lin Yuan had simply made up the name.

The second was that Lin Yuan came from an era even more ancient than he imagined, not only had his techniques not been passed down, even his name had been worn away by the long years.

Dual Origin Great Saint leaned more towards the latter.

With Lin Yuan’s strength, there was no need to lie deliberately. Such a powerful being would disdain lying.

Whoosh!

While Dual Origin Great Saint was deep in thought, the ubiquitous vast spacetime surged onto him.

"Dual Origin Fusion, Tear!"

Dual Origin Great Saint treated it as a great enemy and immediately used his strongest technique, the strongest strike after the fusion of his own path.

This method exhausts a considerable amount of Dual Origin Great Saint’s Origin Source, and he would not use it unless in an emergency. But to contend with Lin Yuan and to remain in this universe, Dual Origin Great Saint did not hold back at all.

Screech.

The terrifying spacetime fissures kept being torn open, and Dual Origin Great Saint tore through multiple layers of spacetime, trying to approach Lin Yuan.

Only by getting close to Lin Yuan could he threaten Lin Yuan.

But moments later, Dual Origin Great Saint was horrified to find that for every layer of spacetime he tore through, tenfold or a hundredfold would be replenished back.

This gave Dual Origin Great Saint a sense of powerlessness, like an ant gazing at the sky, the distance to Lin Yuan not far, but the spacetime in between spanned unknown billions of light-years.

"My fusion power path, unable to tear through spacetime near him?" Dual Origin Great Saint was extremely shocked.

To contend with Lin Yuan, he must be able to threaten Lin Yuan, otherwise, how could he talk about contending? How could he talk about making Lin Yuan retreat? Allowing them to stay within the universe?

And now? Forget threatening Lin Yuan, Dual Origin Great Saint could not even get close, how could he fight?

"I fully fuse two power paths, the eruption of power should easily tear through the internal universe of a peak Chaos Great Saint, yet it’s helpless against this spacetime, what’s the depth of this technique-concentrated spacetime?"

Dual Origin Great Saint tried several more times and found it was still the same, his heart sank instantly.

...

"Black Light Void!"

Black Light Great Saint’s aura suddenly soared, the surrounding Black Light Domain exuding infinite darkness, immediately became deeper, attempting to forcefully expand under the spacetime pressure.

The Black Light Void, is a technique used by Black Light Great Saint by burning his Origin Source, an ultimate sublimation of the Black Light Domain, a capability he would absolutely not use unless in a desperate situation.

After all, burning Origin Source can bring great power improvement, but recovery is equally difficult.

"Enlarge, enlarge, enlarge!"

Black Light Great Saint fully operated the Black Light Domain, and after burning his Origin Source, the power of the Black Light Domain significantly increased, which Black Light Great Saint preferred to call ’Black Light Void’.

But just as the vast spacetime rolled in from all directions, the Black Light Void, that Black Light Great Saint tried his hardest to expand, was immediately compressed back to its original size, and with the increasing spacetime pressure, even the original size could not be maintained, rapidly shrinking.

"My Black Light Void..."

Black Light Great Saint was in disbelief, this was his method to deal with Dual Origin Great Saint, but under Lin Yuan’s condensed spacetime pressure, not to mention resistance, he couldn’t even withstand it.

...

"Damn..."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint also tried to attack Lin Yuan, but was immediately confined by the ubiquitous spacetime, feeling all his strength had nowhere to be used.

"Galaxy Great Saint, dare to engage me in close combat."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint shouted at Lin Yuan, close combat was his strongest suit, his path of chaos evolved power also excelled in this area.

Originally, Wild Barbarian Great Saint had specially cultivated some Secret Techniques to deal with Great Saints adept at domain abilities, but under Lin Yuan’s condensed spacetime pressure, those Secret Techniques had no effect at all.

"Close combat?"

Lin Yuan glanced at him, "You can’t even deal with my external universe, and yet you want to engage in close combat with me?"

The Martial Tao Evolution Road similarly excelled in hand-to-hand combat, but now, being able to rely on the external universe to suppress enemies, Lin Yuan naturally didn’t bother with close combat.

"Condense."

Lin Yuan looked at Wild Barbarian Great Saint, immediately the vast spacetime surged up, directly suppressing Wild Barbarian Great Saint firmly.

"This—"

Further away, Tian Lu Great Saint originally also wanted to seize the opportunity to make a move, not asking to threaten Lin Yuan, but at least able to distract his attention.

But upon seeing, in just an instant, Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, the three Great Saints struggling under the suppression of the surrounding vast spacetime, wobbling precariously.

Tian Lu Great Saint’s heart trembled.

Swoosh!

Tian Lu Great Saint did not advance but retreated, fleeing madly in the opposite direction of Lin Yuan.

As for the earlier agreement with Dual Origin Great Saint to join forces against Lin Yuan?

Against?

Against your mother.
